call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Organic Order Growth >100% and Liquid Cooling Capacity
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Giordano, congratulations on organic orders doubling year-over-year. Could you give us more granularity on how much of this order surge is driven by liquid cooling versus traditional power/thermal, and what is your current manufacturing lead time for complete converged modular infrastructure?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Giordano Albertazzi explained that while direct-to-chip liquid cooling demand is growing exponentially with high-density AI clusters, traditional power switching, UPS, and hybrid thermal systems also saw immense growth as customers retrofit existing facilities. Lead times for standardized modular power solutions have compressed by 30% due to capacity additions in North America and Europe, while CoolTera CDUs and manifold lines scale ahead of hyperscaler schedules.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: After-Hours Digestion (-2.82%) vs. 38.11% GAAP Gross Margin & 25.2% Adj. EBIT Margin
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: David, the Q3 print beat across every metric ($4,312.8M revenue, 38.11% GAAP gross margin, 25.2% adjusted operating margin, $2.21 adjusted EPS), yet the stock is taking a modest -2.82% breather after-hours. Is 25.2% adjusted operating margin nearing a cyclical ceiling, or does operating leverage continue into 2027?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO David Fallon addressed margin durability directly: 'We do not view 25.2% adjusted operating margin as a ceiling—in fact, our Q4 guidance embeds 25.3% to 26.3% adjusted operating margin. With GAAP gross margin expanding 36 bps YoY to 38.11% and SG&A scaling efficiently at 12.9% of sales, higher-value liquid-to-air heat exchangers, busways, and lifecycle services continue to expand our structural margin profile.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Hyperscaler CapEx Trajectory & Multi-Year Backlog Integrity
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: With Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta all accelerating AI data center CapEx into 2027, how far out does Vertiv's current backlog extend, and what safeguards prevent speculative double-ordering among colocation developers?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Giordano Albertazzi stated that Vertiv's order booking protocol requires firm site engineering approvals, utility allocation milestones, and contractual financial commitments, eliminating phantom backlog. Visibility extends through fiscal 2027, supported by $6.2B in total liquidity after the investment-grade credit upgrade and senior notes refinancing.
